<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="id"><head><meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Juniolshop19</title>
<style>
:root{--bg:#0a0a0a;--card:#151413;--line:#2a2722;--tx:#f4efe2;--mut:#a39c8b;--g1:#f7e98e;--g2:#d4a02f;--gold:linear-gradient(135deg,#d4a02f,#f7e98e 50%,#d4a02f);color-scheme:dark;box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
*{box-sizing:border-box}html{scroll-padding-top:70px}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--tx);font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif;line-height:1.5}
header{position:sticky;top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);z-index:20;background:rgba(10,10,10,.92);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:8px 16px}
header img{height:46px}header .sp{flex:1}
nav a{color:var(--mut);text-decoration:none;margin-right:14px;font-size:14px}nav a:hover{color:var(--g1)}
.btn{border:0;border-radius:10px;padding:10px 16px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;background:var(--gold);color:#1a1405;text-decoration:none;display:inline-block;font-size:14px}
.btn.o{background:none;border:1px solid var(--g2);color:var(--g1)}
#cartbtn{position:relative}#cnt{background:#1a1405;color:var(--g1);border-radius:99px;padding:0 7px;margin-left:6px;font-size:12px}
.hero{text-align:center;padding:48px 16px 36px;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at top,#2a2210,transparent 70%)}
.hero img{width:min(300px,70%)}.hero h1{font-size:clamp(24px,5vw,38px);margin:8px 0}
.hero p{color:var(--mut);max-width:520px;margin:0 auto 20px}
.wrap{max-width:1100px;margin:0 auto;padding:24px 16px}
.bar{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;margin-bottom:18px}
.bar input{flex:1;min-width:180px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--tx);border-radius:10px;padding:10px 14px}
.chip{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--mut);border-radius:99px;padding:8px 14px;cursor:pointer}
.chip.on{border-color:var(--g2);color:var(--g1)}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(210px,1fr));gap:16px}
.p{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.ph{aspect-ratio:1;background:#000 center/cover;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.ph img{width:60%;opacity:.35}.ph.real img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;opacity:1}
.p .b{padding:12px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;flex:1}
.p h3{margin:0;font-size:15px}.p small{color:var(--mut)}
.price{font-weight:700;color:var(--g1)}.p .btn{margin-top:auto;width:100%;text-align:center}
.empty{color:var(--mut);text-align:center;padding:40px}
#drawer{position:fixed;top:0;right:0;bottom:0;width:min(380px,100%);background:#111;border-left:1px solid var(--line);transform:translateX(100%);transition:.25s;z-index:30;display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding:16px;padding-top:calc(16px + env(safe-area-inset-top,0px));padding-bottom:calc(16px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px))}
#drawer.open{transform:none}
#items{flex:1;overflow:auto}
.it{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-size:14px}
.q button{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--tx);width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer}
#drawer input,#drawer textarea{width:100%;margin-top:8px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--tx);border-radius:8px;padding:9px;font:inherit}
.tot{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-weight:700;margin:12px 0}
#adm{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.8);z-index:40;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:16px}#adm.open{display:flex}#adm .box{background:#111;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:18px;width:min(420px,100%);max-height:90vh;overflow:auto}#adm input,#adm textarea{width:100%;margin-top:8px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--tx);border-radius:8px;padding:9px;font:inherit}#adm label{display:block;margin-top:10px;font-size:13px;color:var(--mut)}.p .del{margin-top:6px}
footer{border-top:1px solid var(--line);text-align:center;color:var(--mut);padding:28px 16px;font-size:13px}
footer img{height:56px;display:block;margin:0 auto 8px}
</style></head><body>
<header>
<img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Juniolshop19">
<nav><a href="#katalog">Katalog</a><a href="#kontak">Kontak</a></nav><span class="sp"></span>
<button class="btn" id="cartbtn">Keranjang<span id="cnt">0</span></button>
</header>
<section class="hero">
<img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Logo Juniolshop19">
<h1>Selamat datang di Juniolshop19</h1>
<p>Belanja produk pilihan dengan mudah. Pesan lewat WhatsApp atau langsung di toko Shopee kami.</p>
<a class="btn" href="#katalog">Lihat Katalog</a>
<a class="btn o" href="https://s.shopee.co.id/8pnfkwFMxy" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Toko di Shopee</a>
</section>
<main class="wrap" id="katalog">
<div class="bar"><input id="q" placeholder="Cari produk…"><div id="cats" style="display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap"></div></div>
<div class="grid" id="grid"></div>
</main>
<section class="wrap" id="kontak" style="text-align:center">
<h2>Hubungi Kami</h2>
<p style="color:var(--mut)">Ada pertanyaan soal stok atau ongkir? Chat kami.</p>
<p><b>Alamat Toko</b><br>Jl. Sedap Malam RT 09 RW 01, Kel. Kramat, Kec. Senen,<br>Kota Jakarta Pusat</p>
<a class="btn" id="wa" href="#" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Chat WhatsApp</a>
</section>
<footer><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt=""><div>Jl. Sedap Malam RT 09 RW 01, Kel. Kramat, Kec. Senen, Kota Jakarta Pusat</div><div>© 2026 Juniolshop19. Semua hak dilindungi. · <a href="#" id="adminlink" style="color:var(--mut)">Kelola Produk</a></div></footer>

<div id="adm"><div class="box">
<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center"><h3 style="margin:0">Kelola Produk</h3><button class="btn o" id="admclose">Tutup</button></div>
<div id="pinbox"><label>PIN admin</label><input id="pin" type="password" inputmode="numeric"><button class="btn" id="pinok" style="margin-top:10px">Masuk</button></div>
<div id="formbox" style="display:none">
<label>Foto produk</label><input id="pfile" type="file" accept="image/*">
<label>Nama produk</label><input id="pname">
<label>Kategori</label><input id="pcat" placeholder="Contoh: Fashion">
<label>Harga (angka, Rp)</label><input id="pprice" type="number" inputmode="numeric">
<label>Deskripsi singkat</label><textarea id="pdesc" rows="2"></textarea>
<button class="btn" id="padd" style="margin-top:12px;width:100%">Tambah Produk</button>
<p style="color:var(--mut);font-size:12px">Untuk menghapus produk, tutup jendela ini lalu tekan tombol Hapus di kartu produk.</p>
</div>
<div id="pmsg" style="color:var(--g1);font-size:13px;min-height:18px;margin-top:8px"></div>
</div></div>
<aside id="drawer">
<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center"><h3 style="margin:0">Keranjang</h3><button class="btn o" id="close">Tutup</button></div>
<div id="items"></div>
<div class="tot"><span>Total</span><span id="total">Rp 0</span></div>
<input id="nama" placeholder="Nama penerima"><textarea id="alamat" rows="2" placeholder="Alamat pengiriman"></textarea>
<div id="cmsg" style="color:var(--g1);font-size:13px;min-height:18px;margin-top:8px"></div>
<button class="btn" id="co" style="margin-top:6px">Pesan via WhatsApp</button>
</aside>

<script>
/* ===== EDIT DI SINI ===== */
var PIN = "1919"; // PIN untuk membuka menu Kelola Produk (ubah sesuai keinginan)
var WA = "6288809234905"; // ganti dengan nomor WhatsApp toko (format 62…)
var SHOPEE = "https://s.shopee.co.id/8pnfkwFMxy";
// price:0 akan tampil "Hubungi untuk harga". Isi harga asli di sini.
var PRODUCTS = [
{id:1,name:"Kemeja Tactical Navy M-TAC",cat:"Kemeja Tactical",price:0,desc:"Foto contoh dengan bordir nama, emblem, dan patch.",img:"data:image/jpeg;base64,"},
{id:2,name:"PDH Coklat Khaki Lengan Panjang",cat:"PDH / Dinas",price:0,desc:"Foto contoh dengan bordir nama, jabatan, dan emblem dinas.",img:"data:image/jpeg;base64,"},
{id:3,name:"Setelan PDH Coklat Lengan Pendek",cat:"PDH / Dinas",price:0,desc:"Kemeja lengan pendek dan celana. Foto contoh dengan bordir nama dan emblem.",img:"data:image/jpeg;base64,"},
{id:4,name:"Setelan PDH Coklat Lengan Panjang",cat:"PDH / Dinas",price:0,desc:"Kemeja lengan panjang dan celana. Foto contoh dengan bordir nama dan emblem.",img:"data:image/jpeg;base64,"},
{id:5,name:"Kemeja Tactical Hitam",cat:"Kemeja Tactical",price:0,desc:"Foto contoh dengan bordir nama, jabatan, pangkat bahu, dan emblem.",img:"data:image/jpeg;base64,"}
];
/* ======================== */
var LOGO = document.querySelector("header img").src;
var BASE = PRODUCTS, EXTRA = [], ADMIN = false;
try{ EXTRA = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("js19extra")||"[]") || [] }catch(e){ EXTRA = [] }
function build(){ PRODUCTS = EXTRA.length ? EXTRA.slice() : BASE.slice() }
function saveExtra(){ try{ localStorage.setItem("js19extra", JSON.stringify(EXTRA)); return true }catch(e){ document.getElementById("pmsg").textContent = "Penyimpanan penuh. Hapus beberapa produk lama."; return false } }
build();
var rp = function(n){return "Rp " + n.toLocaleString("id-ID")};
var cart = {}, cat = "Semua";
try{ cart = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("js19cart")||"{}") || {} }catch(e){ cart = {} }
function save(){ try{ localStorage.setItem("js19cart", JSON.stringify(cart)) }catch(e){} }
function cats(){
 var c = ["Semua"]; PRODUCTS.forEach(function(p){ if(c.indexOf(p.cat)<0) c.push(p.cat) });
 var el = document.getElementById("cats"); el.innerHTML = "";
 c.forEach(function(x){ var b = document.createElement("button"); b.className = "chip"+(x===cat?" on":""); b.textContent = x;
  b.onclick = function(){ cat = x; cats(); render() }; el.appendChild(b) });
}
function render(){
 var s = document.getElementById("q").value.toLowerCase(), g = document.getElementById("grid"); g.innerHTML = "";
 var list = PRODUCTS.filter(function(p){ return (cat==="Semua"||p.cat===cat) && p.name.toLowerCase().indexOf(s)>-1 });
 if(!list.length){ g.innerHTML = '<div class="empty">Produk tidak ditemukan.</div>'; return }
 list.forEach(function(p){
  var d = document.createElement("div"); d.className = "p";
  d.innerHTML = '<div class="ph'+(p.img?' real':'')+'"><img alt=""></div><div class="b"><small></small><h3></h3><small class="ds"></small><div class="price"></div><button class="btn">Tambah ke Keranjang</button></div>';
  d.querySelector("img").src = p.img || LOGO; d.querySelector("img").alt = p.name;
  d.querySelector("small").textContent = p.cat; d.querySelector("h3").textContent = p.name;
  d.querySelector(".ds").textContent = p.desc; d.querySelector(".price").textContent = p.price ? rp(p.price) : "Hubungi untuk harga";
  d.querySelector(".btn").onclick = function(){ cart[p.id] = (cart[p.id]||0)+1; save(); draw(); openD() };
  if(p.custom && ADMIN){ var x = document.createElement("button"); x.className = "btn o del"; x.textContent = "Hapus";
   x.onclick = function(){ EXTRA = EXTRA.filter(function(e){ return e.id !== p.id }); delete cart[p.id]; saveExtra(); save(); build(); cat = "Semua"; cats(); render(); draw() };
   d.querySelector(".b").appendChild(x) }
  g.appendChild(d);
 });
}
function draw(){
 var el = document.getElementById("items"), t = 0, n = 0; el.innerHTML = "";
 PRODUCTS.forEach(function(p){ var q = cart[p.id]; if(!q) return; t += q*p.price; n += q;
  var r = document.createElement("div"); r.className = "it";
  r.innerHTML = '<div><b></b><br><small></small></div><div class="q"><button>−</button> <span></span> <button>+</button></div>';
  r.querySelector("b").textContent = p.name; r.querySelector("small").textContent = p.price ? rp(p.price) : "Hubungi untuk harga";
  r.querySelector("span").textContent = q;
  var bs = r.querySelectorAll("button");
  bs[0].onclick = function(){ cart[p.id]--; if(cart[p.id]<=0) delete cart[p.id]; save(); draw() };
  bs[1].onclick = function(){ cart[p.id]++; save(); draw() };
  el.appendChild(r) });
 if(!n) el.innerHTML = '<div class="empty">Keranjang masih kosong.</div>';
 document.getElementById("cnt").textContent = n; document.getElementById("total").textContent = rp(t);
}
function openD(){ document.getElementById("drawer").classList.add("open") }
document.getElementById("cartbtn").onclick = openD;
document.getElementById("close").onclick = function(){ document.getElementById("drawer").classList.remove("open") };
document.getElementById("q").oninput = render;
document.getElementById("wa").href = "https://wa.me/" + WA;
document.getElementById("co").onclick = function(){
 var lines = [], t = 0;
 PRODUCTS.forEach(function(p){ var q = cart[p.id]; if(q){ lines.push("• "+p.name+" x"+q+" = "+(p.price ? rp(q*p.price) : "harga menyusul")); t += q*p.price } });
 var cm = document.getElementById("cmsg"); cm.textContent = "";
 if(!lines.length){ cm.textContent = "Keranjang masih kosong."; return }
 var nm = document.getElementById("nama").value.trim(), al = document.getElementById("alamat").value.trim();
 if(!nm || !al){ cm.textContent = "Isi nama penerima dan alamat pengiriman dulu."; return }
 var msg = "Halo Juniolshop19, saya mau pesan:\n"+lines.join("\n")+"\nTotal: "+rp(t)+"\nNama: "+nm+"\nAlamat: "+al;
 var url = "https://wa.me/"+WA+"?text="+encodeURIComponent(msg);
 if(window.open(url, "_blank")){ cm.textContent = "Membuka WhatsApp… tekan Kirim di sana untuk menyelesaikan pesanan." }
 else { cm.innerHTML = '<a style="color:#f7e98e" target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="'+url+'">Ketuk di sini untuk membuka WhatsApp</a>' }
};
function $(i){ return document.getElementById(i) }
$("adminlink").onclick = function(e){ e.preventDefault(); $("adm").classList.add("open") };
$("admclose").onclick = function(){ $("adm").classList.remove("open") };
$("pinok").onclick = function(){
 if($("pin").value === PIN){ ADMIN = true; $("pinbox").style.display = "none"; $("formbox").style.display = "block"; $("pmsg").textContent = ""; render() }
 else { $("pmsg").textContent = "PIN salah." } };
$("padd").onclick = function(){
 var f = $("pfile").files[0], nm = $("pname").value.trim(), pr = parseInt($("pprice").value, 10);
 if(!nm || !pr){ $("pmsg").textContent = "Nama dan harga wajib diisi."; return }
 function done(img){
  EXTRA.push({id:"u"+Date.now(), name:nm, cat:$("pcat").value.trim()||"Umum", price:pr, desc:$("pdesc").value.trim(), img:img, custom:true});
  if(!saveExtra()){ EXTRA.pop(); return }
  build(); cat = "Semua"; cats(); render();
  ["pname","pcat","pprice","pdesc","pfile"].forEach(function(i){ $(i).value = "" });
  $("pmsg").textContent = "Produk ditambahkan." }
 if(!f){ done(""); return }
 var r = new FileReader();
 r.onload = function(){ var im = new Image(); im.onload = function(){
  var s = Math.min(1, 700/Math.max(im.width, im.height)), c = document.createElement("canvas");
  c.width = Math.round(im.width*s); c.height = Math.round(im.height*s);
  c.getContext("2d").drawImage(im, 0, 0, c.width, c.height); done(c.toDataURL("image/jpeg", .8)) };
  im.onerror = function(){ $("pmsg").textContent = "File foto tidak bisa dibaca." }; im.src = r.result };
 r.readAsDataURL(f) };
cats(); render(); draw();
</script></body></html>
